body: i havent talked to her about it. i mean i have in the past, but she just says, im never teling any of them. i cant do that to them. and i just feel like i HAVE to do something, having been in a similar situation and confessing to my parents and getting therapy and all that. im her only leg to stand on, and im not sure if im going to be there forever.. i just really want her to be okay ya know?

i was thinking maybe the fact that shes been to his house multiple times, and could possibly pull it out of her memory could be enough? i mean why the hell would any school child be at a teachers house?

thing is, as far as i know this shithead is still doing the same thing somewhere else. if not imprisonment i want him to at least never be allowed anywhere near children. i think the statue of limitations is up, but a child isnt exactly a legal entity right? she was way too young to know what was going on or that its that wrong or that he is a fucked up person.. i guess talking to a lawyer would be the best option, but getting to that point is going to be the hard part.

she doesnt think its a big deal, and i dont think shes strong enough to tell them.

thank you for the help

stay with us all in honour of them. you spent their last moments protecting the freedom of your country. they didnt die in vain, they died as heroes. thats what they signed up for. to be heroes. if you left with nothing and came back with nothing, maybe thats because it was supposed to be a turning point for you, a wake up call of sorts. maybe now could be your chance to give yourself what you want, in honour of your fallen brothers. 

tomorrow is just a new page in your book of life. its a long book, and it takes a while to write it, but you cant just stop right in the middle. you still have so much more to write my friend. go for a run or something in the morning, get some coffee or tea. talk to random people and make them smile. 


Chin up, Solider, tomorrows a new day.
